title: Zapotecs, Mixtecs and Maya: Peoples Who Are Still Here
goal: Talk about living indigenous cultures and the backstrap loom with a pesar de, pese a and aunque.
grammar: concession with a pesar de que, pese a and aunque

items: I can say that something continues in spite of a difficulty, with *a pesar de*, *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.
I can say where the Zapotec, Mixtec and Maya peoples live.
I can describe the backstrap loom and say why indigenous languages are still spoken.
